---
title: "Add Cloudflare Images transformer"
description: "Drop when the pinned release includes @payloadcms/transformer-cloudflare."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.3. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

Payload 4 moved image processing out of core into upload transformers, and
the only released one, transformer-sharp, can't run on Workers. Without a
transformer, an Offload site stores each upload as it arrives, with no
variants, crop, focal point or format conversion. This backports upstream's
draft Cloudflare Images transformer unchanged. It processes uploads and
serves resized images through a Worker's Images binding, and adds itself
to Payload's publish list, so Offload publishes it as
@adirishi/offload-transformer-cloudflare.

- **Patch:** `transformer-cloudflare`, committed as `feat(transformer-cloudflare): add Cloudflare Images transformer`
- **Upstream:** [payloadcms/payload#18647](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/pull/18647)
- **Tests:** `pnpm --filter @payloadcms/transformer-cloudflare exec vitest run; e2e suite (image variants test)`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0003-feat-transformer-cloudflare-add-Cloudflare-Images-tr.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0003-feat-transformer-cloudflare-add-Cloudflare-Images-tr.patch)
